basic_info.description: FINAL price adjustment!!!  One of the VERY few 1 bed units in this direct area that INCLUDES PARKING!  This stunning live/work loft features 1 bedroom, 1.5 bathrooms, floor to ceiling windows, skylights, and skyline views. Located on the top floor, corner unit with 1 car parking, low HOA dues, and in-unit laundry. Perfect for urban living and working. Intimate 46 unit building in the heart of thriving SoMa. Great walk, bike and commute scores.
